title: Support Persons (सहायक व्यक्ति) Empanelment
salary_range: Rs 9000/- per POCSO case (payable in 3 installments)
age_limit: Minimum 30 years and maximum 65 years (aligned with Child Welfare Committee member selection criteria)
summary: District Child Protection Unit, Rohtas invites applications from eligible candidates for the empanelment of 30 Support Persons under the POCSO Act, 2012 and Rules, 2020. The engagement is purely on an empanelment basis for a duration of 2 years, subject to annual performance review. Interested candidates must send their applications via email to adcp.rohtas@nic.in by 24 December 2026.
eligibility_bullets: Must be a citizen of India and a resident of Rohtas district.
Post-graduate degree in Social Work (MSV)/Sociology/Psychology/Child Development/Law OR Graduation in any faculty with a diploma in Child Rights/Counseling along with 3 years of experience.
Desirable experience of at least 3 years in child rights, child protection, legal work, social work, or counseling.
Clean antecedents with no criminal cases registered or moral turpitude convictions.
how_to_apply_steps: Download the application format available on the official website rohtas.nic.in.
Fill out the application form and attach self-attested copies of educational qualifications, mark sheets, experience certificates, caste certificate, character certificate, and residential proof.
Send the scanned application and documents via email to adcp.rohtas@nic.in before 23:59 hours on 24 December 2026.
